children.name: Teal & Orange
children.description: Cyan city shadows and copper warmth. Best with blue skies, warm buildings and people in mixed light.

children.name: Black & Gold
children.description: Amber lamps and gold signs against charcoal streets. Best with warm night lighting.

children.name: Neon Night
children.description: Electric cyan and violet with vivid red signs. Best with neon streets and coloured reflections.

children.name: Blue & Orange
children.description: Deep blue streets, clean cyan light and bright amber windows. Best with busy city nights.

children.name: Vivid Rainbow
children.description: Deep blue skies, textured clouds and bright warm colour. Best with daylight travel, rooftops and people.

children.name: Earth Tones
children.description: Copper autumn colour with living olive greens. Best with trees, gardens, stone and warm daylight.

children.name: Aqua
children.description: Luminous turquoise water and clear aqua skies with golden foliage. Best with sunlit water, coastlines and blue-sky landscapes.

children.name: Cotton Candy
children.description: Clean pastel pink and baby blue with clear edges and light-filled colour. Best with pale daytime skies, light buildings and soft blue hour.

children.name: Cyberpunk
children.description: Electric purple, violet and cyan with distinct red signs. Best with neon streets, mixed LED light and wet city reflections.

children.name: Bright Beige
children.description: Clean cream highlights and warm natural colour with defined shadows. Best with pale architecture, daylight interiors and people in soft light.

children.name: Euro Black & Orange
children.description: Old-world black and gold: warm timber and amber stone with open, detailed shadows. Best with historic streets, temples and dusk architecture.

children.name: Deep Green
children.description: Lush emerald leaves and moss with rich warm bark. Best with woodland, shaded gardens and forest streams.

children.name: Autumn Red
children.description: Glowing red maples, copper leaves and deep emerald moss. Best with autumn temples, gardens and illuminated foliage.

children.name: Flower Garden
children.description: Luminous roses and clean petal colour against cool, quiet foliage. Best with flower portraits and colourful gardens.

children.name: Dark Forest
children.description: Warm amber light against cool, dark green woodland. Best with green forests; move the soft upper-left beam in Masks to follow the light.

children.name: Warm Library
children.description: Rich mahogany, amber lamps and aged-paper cream with firm dark shadows. Best with bookshops, libraries and warm interiors.

children.name: Bright Food
children.description: Fresh ingredients, clean crockery and bright soft light. Best with food, cafe tables and market produce.
